entities.summary: Yevgeny Stepanovich Savchenko is a Russian politician, who is currently the Senator of Belgorod Oblast on legislative authority since 22 September 2020. He had served as the governor of Belgorod Oblast in Southern Russia from 1993 to 2020. Savchenko is a member of United Russia. Yevgeny Savchenko was a performers & entertainers from Krasnaya Yaruga (b. 1950-04-08, Krasnaya Yaruga). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
